settings.title: Sieve
settings.description: Excludes files and folders before vault indexing
settings.rulesDescription: Paths are relative to the vault root. The first matching rule wins.
settings.syntaxSummary: One rule per line. * matches characters within a name; ** also crosses folders. Prefix ! to include matching paths. Start a comment line with //.
settings.displayNameDescription: Leave empty to use the root folder name.
